title: MORE Custom Dome GAMEPLAY! | Cornucopias
description:
A closer look at our Epic Custom Dome while Jim and David showcase the PVP kit with pre-alpha gameplay and answer community questions.

In this episode of COPI Cafe Josh and Rob announce some new hires, discuss our COPI stake pool, land staking and details on custom dome staking. Our game devs David and Jim join to showcase the PVP pre-alpha gameplay. 

Be sure to check out the newly released "Custom Dome" document to learn all about our upcoming NFT mint! Link: https://links.cornucopias.io/custom-domes-deck-01

00:00 - Intro
00:27 - Beverage Choices
02:02 - New Hires
04:22 - Roadmap/Strategies Adjustments
07:10 - COPI Staking Pool / Rewards
11:00 - Land Staking
12:00 - Custom Dome Staking
12:40 - Custom Dome Sale
21:09 - David and Jim answer questions from the community
26:09 - Custom Dome PVP Gameplay


#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK 

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
